description.description: What this literature studies, in two or three sentences, in the register of its own abstracts.

differs_from_construct.description: Which element of the codebook this literature fails, or how it differs from the target studies.

discriminating_cue.description: The words or framing in a title or abstract that tell this literature apart from an include.

evidence.description: Optional grounding of a tool proposal: cluster id, record ids and verbatim quotes.
